A.thesis_one_line: Maker of lab instruments and the supplies and service that keep them running; business is improving but the share price already assumes faster growth than we expect.
kill_criteria: Core (organic) revenue growth below 3% for two consecutive quarters (FY26 Q3 was 7.3%; FY26 guide is 5.8% to 6.0%).
Consolidated net debt (carrying debt less cash and equivalents, condensed consolidated balance sheet) above 2.5x TTM EBITDA (about 1.1x at 31 Jul 2026).
Non-GAAP operating margin falling below 25% in any quarter once the one-off tariff refund benefit (about 110 bps in Q3 FY26) is stripped out (Q3 FY26 ex-refund: about 27.2%).
Full-year FY27 non-GAAP EPS guidance initiated below $6.60, which would imply growth under 6% on the FY26 guide midpoint of $6.195.
Biocare (acquired 24 Jun 2026, $950 million net) impairment or restructuring charge above $100 million within 24 months of closing.
key_adverse_facts: Q3 FY26 EPS raise includes a one-time $0.06 tariff refund and about 110 bps of margin benefit
GAAP effective tax rate 18.5% in Q3 FY26 versus 8.2% a year ago
$950M Biocare acquisition (24 Jun 2026) lifted consolidated debt to $3.95B
FCF about 74% of non-GAAP net income TTM
data_conflicts: Triage cited general knowledge and 1.5% street upside; filings confirm improving fundamentals, so the issue is price not quality
A.confidence_in_thesis: medium: guidance raised four times but quality of latest raise reduced by one-offs; next earnings date unconfirmed (about late Nov 2026)

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists; own reverse DCF implies about 12% annual FCF growth as first written (WACC 8.5%, SBC added back); restated in DV01 verification to about 16% (WACC ~9.3% = 10y UST 5.17% + ERP 4.5%, SBC-burdened FCF) versus base about 8%, so the valuation is full.
valuation_view_vs_v1.implied_growth_note: 10-yr reverse DCF restated by DV01 (FY27E FCF $1.35B after SBC, WACC ~9.3%, tg 3%): implied about 16.0% versus base about 8%. Original (FY27E FCF $1.5B, WACC 8.5%): 12.1%.

A.scenario_basis: FY26 non-GAAP EPS $6.20; FY30 NTM EPS bear $7.2 at 19x, base $8.9 at 23x, bull $10.2 at 27x; dividend about $1.02 per year

HUM.thesis_one_line: Big Medicare Advantage health insurer in a trough year after losing government quality bonuses; profits should recover, but the price already assumes a strong recovery.
kill_criteria: Insurance segment GAAP benefit ratio above 93.0% for FY26 (guide: 92.75% plus or minus 25 bps) or any 2026 quarterly print above 92.0% outside the normal Q3/Q4 seasonal step-up.
BY2027 Star Ratings (CMS release expected Oct 2026) show less than 25% of Humana MA members in 4-star-or-higher contracts, i.e. no recovery of the 2025 loss.
FY26 adjusted EPS guidance cut below the current 'at least $9.00'.
Debt-to-total capitalization (revolving credit agreement definition; 42.7% at 30 Jun 2026) above 50%, or parent company cash and short-term investments below $500 million.
A CMS RADV extrapolated recovery or DOJ risk-adjustment action with a disclosed estimated loss above $1 billion.
key_adverse_facts: FY26 adjusted EPS guided to at least $9.00 versus $17.14 in FY25; insurance segment guided to about breakeven
Adjusted guidance unchanged for three releases despite YTD adjusted EPS $17.91
2025 Star Ratings suit rejected 14 Oct 2025, appeal pending
DOJ Civil Division information requests on risk adjustment; securities class action pending
data_conflicts: Consolidated cash $6.9B includes regulated subsidiaries; parent cash $1.59B inflated by $1.05B payment timing
GAAP FY26 EPS guide cut twice to at least $6.52 on non-cash put/call valuation items
HUM.confidence_in_thesis: low-to-medium: outcome hinges on the October Star Ratings and benefit-ratio delivery; next earnings date unconfirmed (about early Nov 2026)

Priced above the base case. Original text: about 14.6%.

HUM.scenario_basis: FY26 adjusted EPS floor $9.00; FY30 NTM EPS bear $13 at 12x, base $22 at 15x, bull $30 at 17x; dividends about $10.6 over 3 years

LITE.thesis_one_line: Makes the lasers and optical parts that connect AI data centres; sales doubled in a year, but the share price already assumes the boom keeps compounding.
kill_criteria: Quarterly revenue below the low end of the company's own guidance range in any quarter (Q1 FY27 guide: $1.225 billion to $1.275 billion).
Non-GAAP operating margin below 33% for two consecutive quarters (Q4 FY26: 36.6%; Q1 FY27 guide: 39.5% to 40.5%).
Either of the two largest end customers (26.6% and 15.0% of FY26 revenue) cutting or pausing orders, evidenced by sequential revenue decline of more than 10% in any quarter.
Inventory plus purchase commitments growing more than 2x faster than revenue for two quarters (FY26 inventory $691.6 million, up 47% versus revenue up 83%).
Capital expenditure above 20% of revenue for a full fiscal year while free cash flow stays below 15% of revenue (FY26: capex 15.0%, FCF 10.0% of revenue).
key_adverse_facts: Two customers were 26.6% and 15.0% of FY26 revenue
FY26 FCF only 38% of non-GAAP net income; capex $451M and inventory +47%
Convertible note exchanges cost a $7.76B non-cash loss and about 10.6M new shares
$2.0B convertible preferred issued to NVIDIA in March 2026 adds about 2.9M shares
FY25 non-GAAP operating margin was only 9.7%; annualised volatility about 96%
data_conflicts: Triage flagged negative margin and ROE: verified as a one-time non-cash $7.76B debt-extinguishment loss, operating income was positive $524.8M
Yahoo trailing EPS -$93 is GAAP and distorted by the extinguishment loss
LITE.confidence_in_thesis: medium on business trajectory, low on valuation: guidance beaten three quarters running but concentration and cycle risk are high; next earnings date unconfirmed (about early Nov 2026)

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists; own reverse DCF implies about 31% annual FCF growth for nine years after FY27 versus base about 14%.
valuation_view_vs_v1.implied_growth_note: 10-yr reverse DCF (FY27E FCF $1.2B, WACC 11%, tg 3.5%): implied about 31% versus base about 14%

LITE.scenario_basis: FY26 non-GAAP EPS $8.67; FY30 NTM EPS bear $14 at 15x, base $32 at 26x, bull $50 at 30x; no dividend
